payload.core_mechanism_summary: Pattern-based constructive formula: for n=1 counts mod 6, n=2 special cases, n≥3 floor(n*m/2)*2. Uses bit shift for multiplication, no actual search.
payload.rationale: Solution is a closed-form mathematical construction, not search or DP. Chosen subtype is closest among given candidates due to presence of bitwise shift, though it is not enumeration.
